title: J&K: Kishtwar girl dies after ‘forced abortion’ bid, teacher held
content: a 14-year-old girl from j&K’s Kishtwar died after an alleged forced abortion attempt . authorities placed teacher Khalid Hussain under suspension after his arrest under Pocso and other sections . her postmortem revealed she was around five months’ pregnant, police say .

title: ‘Bribe to suppress rape case’ allegation: Mann’s wife sends notice to ex-judge
content: the notice warned that failure to respond within the stipulated deadline would invite legal proceedings and require Singh to appear before a court . the announcement came after the national human rights commission directed the chief secretary and director general of police to inquire into the allegations . NHRC member Priyank Kanoongo said the commission had received the complaint from justic .

title: TikTok to pay $400 million in US child privacy settlement over alleged violations
content: the settlement marks one of the largest recoveries under the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (Copra) the justice department had sued TikTok and ByteDance in 2024 . the lawsuit alleges that the companies unlawfully collected children's personal information .

title: H1N1 alert: Health ministry lists symptoms to look for as Delhi crosses 1,700 cases
content: swine flu can show up through symptoms including fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches and fatigue . it advised people not to ignore persistent symptoms and to seek medical advice at the nearest healthcare centre .

title: BJP forms Gen Z outreach team: Nabin, Smriti and Vinod Tawde among key faces
content: the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has formed a dedicated team to spearhead its proposed programme . the team includes BJP national president Nitin Nabin, national general secretaries Smriti Irani and Vinod Tawde, Gujarat minister Harsh Sanghavi .

title: Sajjan Kumar 'role model' post: Sikh leaders protest outside Rahul's residence
content: sikh leaders and families affected by the 1984 anti-sikh riots stage a protest outside Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's residence in new Delhi . some Congress leaders described former party leader Sajjan Kumar as a "hero" and "role model" a dSGMC leader questioned whether the Congress endorsed the remarks .

title: Yogi, Akhilesh, Mayawati given Rs 10 lakh bulletproof jackets ahead of UP polls
content: the bulletproof jackets cost around Rs 10 lakh each . eight leaders received the jackets in the first phase, 44 in the second phase . security arrangements have also been extended to several other BJP leaders . BJP leader Aparna Yadav is also on the list, ANI reports .

title: ‘From defence to offence’: Iran warns of pre-emptive strikes as Trump ramps up threats
content: the warning comes as president Donald Trump steps up pressure on Tehran . he threatens unprecedented sanctions and suggests that Washington retains broad military options in the region . Iran signals readiness for pre-emptive action and is preparing to respond to attacks with broader and faster retaliation .

title: Former world champion boxer Zolani Tete shot dead outisde home
content: former world champion boxer Zolani Tete was shot dead outside his home . the 38-year-old was arriving at his residence and was sitting in his car waiting for the gate to open . a woman, 27, was also shot several times and is receiving treatment .

title: 'Judges are not gods, will not get every judgment right': Justice Sanjay Karol
content: justice Sanjay Karol said judges "are not gods and they will not get every judgment right" he urged other judges to look beyond the facts of a case and see the person behind every litigant . the supreme court bid farewell to justice Karol on his last working day .

title: Abandoned Helsinki oil caverns now heat 25,000 homes for a year
content: two abandoned underground oil caverns in Mustikkamaa were filled with 260,000 cubic metres of hot water . the project, which began construction in 2018 and was completed in 2021, marks a unique case even on a global scale . stored heat corresponds to the heating of 25,000 one-bedroom apartments all year round .

title: Age limit, two-term cap: DMK passes 9 resolutions for organisational overhaul
content: DMK's executive committee passed nine resolutions aimed at radically restructuring the organisation . the former chief minister says the changes would be "stringent" and difficult for some to accept . he says he will make several changes in the party’s organisational structure .
